changeSet.sql:
UPDATE risks SET damage_operations = CASE damage_operations WHEN 100 THEN 10 WHEN 80 THEN 8 WHEN 50 THEN 5 WHEN 20 THEN 2 ELSE damage_operations END, damage_assets = CASE damage_assets WHEN 100 THEN 10 WHEN 80 THEN 8 WHEN 50 THEN 5 WHEN 20 THEN 2 ELSE damage_assets END, damage_individuals = CASE damage_individuals WHEN 100 THEN 10 WHEN 80 THEN 8 WHEN 50 THEN 5 WHEN 20 THEN 2 ELSE damage_individuals END, damage_other_orgs = CASE damage_other_orgs WHEN 100 THEN 10 WHEN 80 THEN 8 WHEN 50 THEN 5 WHEN 20 THEN 2 ELSE damage_other_orgs END WHERE created_by = 'system_seed' AND ( damage_operations IN (100, 80, 50, 20) OR damage_assets IN (100, 80, 50, 20) OR damage_individuals IN (100, 80, 50, 20) OR damage_other_orgs IN (100, 80, 50, 20) );
UPDATE risks SET general_risk = (damage_operations + damage_assets + damage_individuals + damage_other_orgs) / 4.0 WHERE created_by = 'system_seed';
